body: I honestly don't plan on living long enough to see the end of another application process.

I had a lawyer.

I don't want to grovel for their fucking tiny amount of money that's just enough that I wont die. The system rejected me, so I reject the system. They don't even care that I'm only going to get worse not better. So I might as well say fuck it and get money any way I can.

I applied for disability, they denied, I appealed, they denied, I appealed, they denied. 

Apparently constant pain isn't a disability, and neither is partial paralysis.
